🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 20, 2026

Moon, in Aries, holds a sextile to Pluto, in Aquarius. Two ways of valuing a thing, meeting at one point: what you hold gets named without shrinking in the telling.

Easier — Letting go of something you had kept out of habit.
Harder — Wide gestures, vague promises, starting on appetite alone.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon is with you, close enough to read the small print. Cardinal fire opens and closes the same file. The square of three weeks ago is off it now.

♉ TAURUS
Venus rules you from its own Libra. From Scorpio, Sun quotes your worth back at you. Earth that holds on, charged for holding. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Aries, Moon hands you an opening. Mutable air: two answers, and both are affordable. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Aries with no title of its own. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, and the ease asks its own attention. Water that starts things, started cheaply. Mercury let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Moon in Aries sides with you before you have argued. Fire that holds on, holding without strain. The hold Mercury had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, where nothing is owed to it. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Mutable earth: two answers, neither expensive. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Aries, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Air that starts things, billed for starting. Four weeks ago Venus was still in Scorpio: the ground has moved.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. Mars has covered 14° since early November, quietly.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, is a stranger in Leo: neither strong nor weak. From Aries, Moon concedes the point early. Fire that changes shape, and the shape fits. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Aries, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Cardinal earth: the beginning has a price on it. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Moon sextiles you from Aries: an opening to be reached for. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The square to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter governs you, untitled in Leo. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. Three weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Mercury; that is finished.
